chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Join Kids Heart Family  Hello Boys!  What's going on over here?  We have a match against the teams from the other neighbourhood  but we can't agree upon anything.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Not even on who will be the captain and what kind of a game we will play.  Oh! That's bad!  You need to be a bundle of sticks boys and not single sticks.  What do you mean?  You'll know in just a few minutes.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: The World's Greatest  Once upon a time, an old farmer lived with his three sons.  They were lucky to have a good crop every year  and grew richer every year.  But they did not have any respect in the village

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: because the sons kept fighting amongst themselves.  One day, the farmer called his sons.  My sons, I am now growing old and it is time for me to retire.  But before I do so, I have a competition set for you all.  The winner will get a big reward from me.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: What do we need to do father?  Here are three bundles of sticks.  Each bundle has ten sticks in it.  The one who breaks each stick the fastest will be the winner.  It was an easy task and the sons broke each stick into two quickly.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: As soon as they had done it, they started fighting again.  I won father.  How can you win when I broke all the sticks first?  I win.  None of you broke the sticks as fast as I did.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: So I am the winner.  Wait, the competition isn't over yet.  I still have one more task for you.  The farmer now handed over another bundle of ten sticks each to each son.  Now I want you to break the entire bundle of sticks into two.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Remember, you have to break the whole bundle at one go.  Don't pull out individual sticks.  The sons tried hard.  But they could not break the bundles.  Father, it is not possible to break the bundle.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: Individual sticks can be broken.  Yes, the bundle is very very strong.  Exactly.  You three are also like the sticks.  As long as you stay united like the bundle, nobody can break you.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: But if you keep fighting amongst yourselves,  you are like the individual sticks.  Easy to break.  The three sons understood the valuable lesson their father had taught them.  And never fought again.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We have also been behaving like the three sons, dear.  Isn't it?  We have been fighting amongst ourselves.  Yes, and if we continue like this, the other team will easily defeat us.  We will not fight anymore.

chunk.title: The Bundle Of Sticks Story  Stories for Kids
chunk.text: We will find a way to play together like a real team.  That's a good decision boys. All the best.  Thanks dear.  For your favorite rhymes, stories and more, join Kids Hat Family.  Subscribe here.
